name: DiF-Hash-B
definition: A two-factor model in the Factor Fields framework, extending the single-factor Instant-NGP (iNGP) model. It uses a localized coefficient field and a global basis field with periodic transformations to alleviate feature collision.
summary: DiF-Hash-B is a two-factor neural field model that improves reconstruction quality over Instant-NGP by using localized and global fields to reduce feature collision, at the cost of increased size and training time.
